talking-to-the-odd-old-man-without-any-b.player: So how is the sorting going?

talking-to-the-odd-old-man-without-any-b.speaker: Odd Old Man
talking-to-the-odd-old-man-without-any-b.text: It's going well, especially now I have all the bones I need.

talking-to-the-odd-old-man-without-any-b.speaker: Odd Old Man
talking-to-the-odd-old-man-without-any-b.text: There are still a few bits and pieces I wouldn't mind, but that's the way things go.

talking-to-the-odd-old-man-without-any-b.player: Well if I see any bones I think you might like I'll bring them over.

talking-to-the-odd-old-man-without-any-b.speaker: Odd Old Man
talking-to-the-odd-old-man-without-any-b.text: Cheers, we, err, that is myself and the museum staff, really appreciate it.

handing-in-some-bones.player: I have some bones for you.

handing-in-some-bones.speaker: Odd Old Man
handing-in-some-bones.text: Great! Let me take a look at them.

handing-in-some-bones.speaker: Odd Old Man
handing-in-some-bones.text: Wonderful! I'll put this with the rest.

handing-in-some-bones.player: No problem. I'll be back if I find some more.

trying-to-hand-in-unclean-bones.player: I have some bones for you.

trying-to-hand-in-unclean-bones.speaker: Odd Old Man
trying-to-hand-in-unclean-bones.text: Great! Just clean them up in the pot-boiler and hand them over.

finishing-up.player: I have some bones for you.

finishing-up.speaker: Odd Old Man
finishing-up.text: Great! Let me take a look at them.

finishing-up.speaker: Odd Old Man
finishing-up.text: That...that covers all the bones I was searching for!

finishing-up.player: Well I'm glad to have furthered the cause of the museum.
I just hope everyone will enjoy the finished displays.

finishing-up.speaker: Odd Old Man
finishing-up.text: Yes, I'm sure EVERYONE will get a chance to enjoy my work.

finishing-up.speaker: Odd Old Man
finishing-up.text: Well anyway, I have a few items I've put together in my spare time if you want one.

finishing-up.speaker: Odd Old Man
finishing-up.text: I have a ram skull helm or a snazzy bonesack like mine.

steps.speaker: Odd Old Man
steps.text: Come and see me if you lose that one, I have plenty more!

steps.speaker: Odd Old Man
steps.text: Well chosen, I knew you had taste!

steps.speaker: Odd Old Man
steps.text: Come and see me if you lose that one, I have plenty more!

steps.speaker: Odd Old Man
steps.text: I... Well... I do have many of each. I suppose it wouldn't be a problem.
If the player's inventory is full:

steps.speaker: Odd Old Man
steps.text: Well, as much as I'd like to toss them into the dirt and all, I think it's best if you came back later with an empty backpack.

steps.speaker: Odd Old Man
steps.text: I do think they go well together, actually.

steps.speaker: Odd Old Man
steps.text: Come and see me if you lose either one, I have plenty more!
